meta.name: verification-before-completion
meta.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在提交前自动运行验证命令并确认结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在提交代码前强制运行测试或检查
copy.tagline_en: Run verification commands and confirm output before committing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to enforce running tests or checks before committing code

howto.what: Claude 在声称工作完成前，必须先运行验证命令并检查输出，确认通过后才能做出成功声明。它不再仅凭推测或信任代理报告就下结论。
howto.when: 当你即将声称任务完成、测试通过、Bug 修复，或准备提交代码、创建 PR 时触发。

say.text: 运行测试并告诉我结果。
say.note: Claude 会执行测试命令并报告通过/失败。
Claude 会运行构建命令并输出结果。

say.text: 验证这个 Bug 是否已修复。
say.note: Claude 会重现原始症状并确认修复。

howto.what_en: Before claiming work is complete, Claude must run verification commands and check output to confirm success. It no longer relies on assumptions or agent reports alone.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you are about to claim task completion, test passing, bug fix, or before committing or creating a PR.

say_en.text: Run the tests and tell me the results.
say_en.note: Claude will execute test command and report pass/fail.
Claude will run build command and output result.

say_en.text: Verify if this bug is fixed.
say_en.note: Claude will reproduce original symptom and confirm fix.
